# Sarnia Heating & Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for Sarnia. Air-conditioning repair covers diagnosis of central and ductless cooling equipment, including electrical starting, refrigerant, airflow, coil, and control faults.

Email: contact@sarniaheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://sarniaheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: Sarnia, Point Edward, Corunna, Petrolia, Forest, Wyoming. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
